generatorResources.scope: Sum CPU milliseconds divided by one common elapsed window. Per-process CPU snapshots include waiting after each gameplay drain until report request; report serialization is excluded. ELU weights total active/idle milliseconds, not a mean of process fractions. RSS peak is a conservative sum of lifetime peaks, not simultaneous native-server memory.

limitations: Actual transport scheduling with arranged high-HP actors/targets, two seeded lethal rounds/material drops per actor plus natural repeated respawns/visible loot. Not every natural encounter.

Actual transport and prediction without rendered DOM/canvas; prediction limits are not measured visual FPS. Generator input runs at20Hz while the actual browser uses RAF; both clamp frame integration at250ms.

Signed central auth uses local verified fixture replies. Generators are up to four separate OS processes, one per channel, on the same4CPU quota; their resources are reported separately and still compete for host CPU.
Main ingress architecture matches installed startup; delivery source provenance is the exact pinned archived entry plus approved noDelay change, not a byte-verified live R84 ingress.
No Caddy/TLS or WAN latency, complete dungeon/arena/guild/trade/admin crowd mix, complete static assets, full historical load suite or long-duration capacity guarantee.

queueObservation.scope: Server main writer FIFO sampled separately from generator input-await age. Not browser visual stop measurement.

clientTransport.implementation: Actual pinned Core511Transport + OwnPrediction in up to four separate OS processes, sharded by channel, no simulated server acknowledgements

attackCadence.stats: Native calculateEquipmentStats using current own/inventory/settings projection
attackCadence.serverCorrection: Exact basic_attack_cadence429 is recorded and sets remaining native deadline; cooldownRemainingMs/nextAttackAtMs update optimistic deadline

clientTransport.potionStock: Automatic HP charge; manual potions remain64. Native charge debit equals healing; record this derivation and positive no-op ACKs separately.

passScope: Native economy, healthy transport/no faults or live input cancellation, drained slots, unchanged core and delivery ingress. Latency and caps are a separate performance gate.
ackSemantics: Generator wire input-to-result latency; attack202 is provisional. Native writer waits/durable outcomes separate. Real600ms OwnPrediction cap; no rendered FPS inference.
